title: Open Values Ontology v0.4
description: The menu people browse the catalogue by: eight human needs, and the areas of life with their categories, each category tagged with a need and linked to its facts file once one is built. Conscious Consuming keeps it.

version.description: The version of this navigation file, as a whole number. The current file is version 4.

note.description: A paragraph for maintainers explaining how the file is organised and what changed in this version.

types.description: The kinds of thing an entry can be: Products, Services, Media, Organizations and Initiatives. Each category names one of these.

needs.description: The eight human needs that people browse by first, such as nourish or move, each with a short sentence saying what it covers.

domains.description: The areas of life, such as "Food & drink", each with its list of categories. Every category appears here exactly once.

id.description: The need's id: nourish, care, keep-a-home, connect, move, learn, give-and-act or protect. Categories point at it in their need field.

label.description: The need's name as shown on the site, such as "NOURISH".

reads.description: One sentence of up to 140 characters saying what the need covers, shown under its name.

label.description: The area of life's name, such as "Food & drink".

categories.description: The categories in this area of life, in the order they are shown.

label.description: The category's name as shown to people, such as "Plant-based milk".

cid.description: The id of the facts file for this category, such as "plant-based-milk". A category with a cid is live on the site. One without it is shown as "Not yet covered".

type.description: What kind of thing the category's entries are: Products, Services, Media, Organizations or Initiatives.

need.description: The id of the need this category is listed under, such as "nourish".

group.description: The group the category sits in inside its area of life, such as "Dairy and alternatives".

facet.description: An optional finer label under the category, the fourth level of the older area, group, category, facet tree. The current file does not use it.
